date: # the day it plays, YYYY-MM-DD (leave blank to repeat the row above)
type: # clue (the theme clue, once), answer, special (the one answer that names the theme and touches two opposite edges) or extra (another word on the board that earns hints)
text: # the clue text, or the word in letters A to Z
cells: # for answer and special: each letter's square as row-column, counting from 1 at the top left, separated by spaces (the board is 8 rows of 6 columns); blank for clue and extra
